text:
sara: Quick take — re: dark theme tweaks. Spent a bit with the dashboard yesterday; charts look muddy when overlaid on #0b0d10. Thoughts on raising contrast for series lines?
mike: Agree, lines disappear in busy charts. Maybe move background to #0a0a0b -> #0f1113 for panels so grid/lines pop.
nana: @mike do you mean change panel bg or overall canvas? small shift could help text legibility too.
sara: Panel bg only. Canvas stays near-black. We want depth without flattening lines.
leo: From an accessibility POV we need >=3:1 for smaller text and UI elements. For critical chart lines 4.5:1 would be ideal. Right now some of our pastel accents are <2:1.
mike: Noted. Current accent palette: `--accent-1: #6fc3ff`, `--accent-2: #9d7cff`, `--accent-3: #ffb86b`. Those look great on light but low contrast on dark.
sara: Proposal: desaturate and darken accents by ~10-15% and increase saturation for key series. Example ideas: `#4aa8e6`, `#7a5bd1`, `#e18a3f`.
nana: I like that. Also for syntax highlighting in logs panel — current inline code uses `#9ed0ff` on dark which is harsh. Can we use `#8cc3ee` for inline and `#5fa1d0` for keywords?
mike: Quick check — if we change accents, do we need to update token names? (i.e., `accent-1` -> `accent-primary`). We should keep tokens semantic not color-specific.
sara: Agreed — rename tokens to semantic roles in the next token sweep: `accent-primary`, `accent-action`, `accent-warning`. Keep legacy mapping for a release.
leo: Also raise the chart axis ticks to `#c9ccd1` (current `#9ea1a6` is too faint). That hits 4.6:1 against panel bg in my calc.
design-bot: accessibility-checker: palette contrast report attached (summary): 3 tokens failing -> recommended adjustments: accent-2 desaturate 12%, axis color +20% luminance.
mike: Can we ship a small A/B? Variant A = desaturated accents + panel bg + axis change. Variant B = keep accents but add 1px outline to lines (lighter stroke). We can test with telemetry for chart click/drop hover rates.
sara: Let's A/B for 2 weeks. Mike please build both variants behind `feature/dark-theme-contrast`. Ana coordinate with analytics for metrics. Leo please confirm new tokens meet WCAG.
nana: Copy nits: in the console header we currently say "Latency (p95)" — let's change to "Latency (95th percentile)" for clarity in the tooltip only, not the header.
sara: Good catch. Small copy tweaks in tooltips only.
mike: I'll push CSS and tokens today. PR will include a tiny storybook preview and a screenshot grid.
leo: I'll run the accessibility sweep Monday and post the color ratios.
sara: Perfect. Follow-ups: (1) Mike create PR, (2) Ana set up A/B, (3) Leo verify. Revisit next design sync. :thumbsup:
mike: On it.
design-bot: deploy-notice: branch feature/dark-theme-contrast ready for review.
